title: gate
description: The gate job of the proof run workflow hears Proof run attested: it needs the attest job, so on a pull request it runs once the attestation is kept, also when the suites or the attest job fail, and not when the run is cancelled. It checks out the pull request's base commit into a folder of its own, builds assure there from the base's cmd/assure and internal/assure, and runs that binary in the change's checkout with the Lathe the workflow builds from LATHE_REF: assure gate change for the pull request's head against its base, which reads the attestation from GitHub's store and verifies it. Nothing from the change's tree runs. When the gate cannot run, such as when Lathe or assure does not build, the job fails with a line that says the gate did not run.
